outcome: Offspring OGTT C-peptide concentrations at 10-14 years
cohort: The study included 4,121 mother-child dyads participating in the Hyperglycemia and Adverse Pregnancy Outcome Follow-up Study (HAPO FUS).
finding: Gravida fasting and 1-hour OGTT C-peptide concentrations were positively correlated with cord blood C-peptide, offspring C-peptide and insulin concentrations, insulinogenic index and HOMA-IR at ages 10-14 years, but inversely correlated with insulin sensitivity.
